claim: Binary task-level pass@k framing in agentic SWE benchmarks hides 'near miss' cases where models pass over 90% of a task's tests but still score 0% because full-task pass requires all tests to pass.
stance_target: Binary/whole-task evaluation obscures graded partial competence across benchmark types, not just function-level code generation
scope_conditions: 80 agentic SWE tasks across 8 uncontaminated repos (C/C++, Java, MERN), IDE-native tool interface
quoted_support: Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro Preview, and Claude Opus 4.5 all repeatedly achieve 91.7% test pass rates across all five attempts yet score 0% under pass@5.
